svg.title: OSRS backing map with smaller standard flags that swap to hover flags
svg.desc: Self-contained SVG generated from Backing_Map.png plus region Top overlays. Standard region flag icons are visible by default at 75 percent scale and switch to hover region flag icons when a region becomes active.
